programme.desc: Charlie Summerville gives his cabin-build crew a much-needed vacation, but their Aleutian fishing adventure does not go to plan. Umnak cattle rancher Pat Harvie resurrects a mechanical beast. Kodiak fishing guide and tracker, Nick Blanco, goes log hunting to stretch his finances.

programme.title: Life on the Edge
programme.desc: In Kodiak, Nick Blanco takes a break from construction to go guiding to solve his financial problems, while in Cold Bay Steph Summerville guides her first wildfowl hunt of the season. At Volcano Bay, a salmon run brings out the bears causing the team to down tools.

programme.title: Life on the Edge
programme.desc: The Summervilles' wildfowl hunting season is in full swing, with brant geese gracing the trophy shelf and the dinner table. On the island of Umnak, ranchers Pat and Connie Harvie and engineer Donovan perfect their volcano escape plan and Kodiak fishing guide, Nick Blanco shows two VIPs round his cabin build.

programme.title: Life on the Edge
programme.desc: Captain Charlie's cabin build schedule is on the rocks, with a transport boat beached at Volcano Bay and unable to transfer much-needed supplies. Over on Umnak Island, Pat and Connie Harvie and engineer Donovan must use their Aleutian ingenuity to battle the oncoming winter. On Kodiak, Nick Blanco ventures into the wild waters of the Shelikof Strait in search of shoals of silver salmon.

programme.title: Life on the Edge
programme.desc: On the volcanic Umnak Island, Pat and Connie Harvie must come face-to-face with their feral herd as they go in search of the perfect spot for a satellite corral. Charlie Summerville and his family may have won the battle with their cabin on Volcano Bay, but have they lost the war when it comes to their luxury yacht, after a family outing goes wrong?

programme.title: Life on the Edge
programme.desc: Charlie has to come to terms with the damage inflicted on his family and business after a catastrophic boat accident. Over on Umnak Pat and Conne Harvie tackle last-minute fixes as a buyer takes interest in their multi-million dollar ranch. At Larsen Bay, Nick Blanco can finally stand back and admire his own little place in paradise.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's UNCHARTED
programme.desc: Jim is unprepared for the extreme mountain environment of France's Chartreuse mountain range.

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.desc: On this episode of North American Whitetail, Editor-in-Chief Haynes Shelton and Associate editor Blake Garlock kick off the season by crossing the border to Canada pursuing big deer in Alberta. Blake walks us though on how to plan for big swings in temperatures on our From The Stand Segment, and we learn about buying the right compact tractor from Dr. James Kroll on our Build Your Own Deer Factory. Big Buck Profile heads to the Iowa Deer Classic where Haynes spends time looking at the Mike Weatherly buck!
